summary: Native Node 24 TypeScript packaging tools. prepare-clash-cli stages prebuilt unified runtime; prepare-acp-harnesses stages installed ACP dependencies; prune-packaged-architectures is the electron-builder afterPack hook. The afterPack hook prunes both runtime locations and rewrites bundled Remotion dylib dependencies to loader-relative paths before hardened signing.
verification: Strict source checking through root tsconfig.quality.json; Vitest fixture tests cover artifact layout, executable media payloads and platform wrappers. Staged dependencies use the shared root runtime-dependency-identity helper so dependency-only upgrades retire the Host. Import guards keep helper imports side-effect free. Do not run prepare commands merely to test them: they replace build directories and can install dependencies.
